blocks.x: IoT, Twin & Robotics — twins that drive decisions, sensors that mount on live assets, maintenance that people actually adopt.

A twin that does not change a decision is a 3D screenshot. Predictive maintenance fails socially before it fails statistically. The sensor network that pays is the one that mounts without stopping the line.
These positions come from instrumented fleets — 1,842 assets and counting in the reference program.
